title: Emotional Intimacy
summary: Emotional intimacy is feeling deeply known and accepted — able to share fears, hopes and vulnerabilities with a partner. It grows through honest conversations and feeling heard.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
